task: Escribe 5 frases sobre tu rutina: a qué hora te levantas, qué desayunas, cómo vas al trabajo o a clase y qué haces por la noche.
paragraphs: I'm Ben and I'm a nurse. I work at a hospital in Manchester.
I get up at six o'clock every day. I have a shower and I have breakfast: toast and tea. I don't drink coffee. At seven o'clock I take the bus to work. The bus is always full!
I start work at half past seven. I work with doctors and other nurses. My job is difficult, but I love it. I have lunch at one o'clock in the hospital café.
I finish work at four o'clock. In the evening I cook dinner and I watch TV with my wife, Sara. She is a teacher. We go to bed at ten o'clock, because we are always tired!
